allowed.reason: Test fixture generator that fills every constructor of every card model, so the export golden test covers every field without a hand-written builder per model.
Build tooling on the host JVM that names a failure in a Gradle warning; it is never shipped or minified.
Reads the hidden pathList and dexElements fields of the app class loader to list the dex files actually loaded.
Calls the hidden android.os.SELinux context methods, which are absent from the SDK.

Single owner of hidden platform failure identity: ServiceSpecificException, ParcelableException and DeadSystemRuntimeException are absent from the SDK, so only their full class name identifies them, and the public errorCode of a ServiceSpecificException can only be read reflectively.
Single owner of the android.os.ServiceManager calls, which are hidden from the SDK; probes ask it for registrations the public APIs never expose.
Single owner of the android.os.SystemProperties read, which is hidden from the SDK; probes compare this Java path with native and getprop reads.
Privacy guard asserting that the snapshot type declares no field that could retain the device unique ID or key request data.
Reads the hidden framework fields named by custom ROM signatures; the presence of those fields is the evidence.
Invokes only the hidden Debug.dumpHprofData(String, FileDescriptor) overload in the isolated VM without adding process-wide hidden API exemptions.
Loads XposedBridge when a framework injected it and reads its fields; the classes of the values found are the evidence.
The implementation classes of the class loaders in the parent chain are the evidence of an injected loader.
Resolving the Xposed framework classes through a class loader is the detection.
The class of an installed hook callback is the evidence.
Skips its own stack frames by comparing frame class names with its own class name, which minification renames consistently in both.
Creates an inert IBinder on the JVM, where the framework Binder cannot be constructed.

Calls hidden PackageManager binder methods through HiddenApiBypass; the service class and method signatures reported when a method is missing distinguish a vendor signature change from reflection filtering.
Exercises the reflective method gateway against fake service methods.

Reads the hidden ApplicationInfo.zygotePreloadName field, which is absent from the SDK, through HiddenApiBypass.getInstanceFields so a manager's zygote preload name can match; it adds no process-wide hidden-api exemption, so other detectors keep observing the default policy.
Calls a hidden Keystore2 grant method to probe KeyMint capabilities.
Reaches the KeyStoreManager grant methods that are hidden below Android 16 through HiddenApiBypass.
Wraps the hidden Keystore2 service and security level binders through their hidden proxy constructors.
Hidden Keystore2 grant helpers: hidden class loading through HiddenApiBypass and hidden response field reads.
Builds hidden KeyParameter arrays and calls the hidden generateKey signature; the security level class named when the signature is missing is evidence of which implementation answered.
Reads hidden KeyMetadata accessors and KeyParameter tag constants.
Calls hidden Keystore2 service methods reflectively; the binder proxy class named when a hidden method is missing is evidence of which keystore implementation answered.
Issues hidden Keystore2 grant calls and reads hidden response fields.
Reads grant entries through the hidden Keystore2 getKeyEntry call.

Creates, updates and finishes hidden Keystore2 operations reflectively; the security level or operation binder class named when a hidden method is missing is evidence of which keystore implementation answered.
Shared hidden Keystore2 helpers: hidden class loading through HiddenApiBypass, field access and parcel argument construction.
Captures hidden Keystore2 replies through java.lang.reflect.Method handles.
Installs a dynamic proxy on the hidden Keystore2 binder to capture raw transactions, which needs HiddenApiBypass, hidden fields and proxies.
Reports the runtime classes of the Keystore2 service, security level and operation descriptor, which identify a replaced keystore implementation.
Calls the hidden Keystore2 supplementary attestation info method through HiddenApiBypass.
